title: Every Node a Mirror
subtitle: The Vision of Indra's Network
description: How an ancient metaphor of infinite interconnection becomes the blueprint for a new kind of digital network — one where every device reflects the whole.

title: Your Story Is Your Key
subtitle: Identity Without Permission
description: A radical rethinking of digital identity — where your cryptographic keys emerge from your own narrative, and no authority stands between you and your name.

title: Your Files Live With You
subtitle: Storage That Follows You Home
description: What happens when your data isn't trapped in someone else's cloud? Content-addressed storage that moves with you across devices and networks.

title: Nobody Owns the Conversation
subtitle: Stewardship Over Ownership
description: The difference between hosting a conversation and owning it. How communities can govern their own spaces without landlords or platforms.

title: The Heartbeat of Community
subtitle: An Economy of Gratitude
description: Beyond transactions: a token system where value flows from genuine contribution and gratitude, not speculation or extraction.

title: Your Network Has an Immune System
subtitle: Moderation Without Moderators
description: How a network can protect itself from abuse without centralized censors — using trust propagation, stake-weighted signals, and community immunity.

title: Shared Roots, Different Branches
subtitle: How Indra's Network and Anytype Diverge from Common Ground
description: Two projects built on CRDTs and encryption reached different conclusions about what decentralization is for — a deep comparison of philosophy and architecture.

title: Two Paths to Decentralization
subtitle: Why Indra's Network Chose a Different Road Than Logos
description: How two projects with the same diagnosis of a broken internet reached opposite conclusions about blockchain, trust, and what it means to ship.

title: Developer's Guide
subtitle: Building on Indra's Network
description: Technical reference for developers: architecture overview, protocol specifications, API patterns, and integration guides for building on the mesh.
